language_task: Put the strawberry into the bowl.
outcome_evidence: The robot closes its gripper around the strawberry at frames 64–70 and carries it toward the blue bowl at frames 73–95, visible in wrist_cam and right_base_cam. At frames 96–103, wrist_cam shows the gripper opening and the strawberry settling inside the bowl. Frames 108–184 in left_base_cam and wrist_cam confirm that the strawberry remains in the bowl as the empty gripper withdraws. No failed acquisition, unintended collision, or unrelated object disturbance is visible.
